Definition: Unique system-generated identifier of the accounting transaction.
Validation: Unique per company and fiscal year; gapless sequence

Definition: Payment voucher reference where the transaction is a disbursement.
Validation: Mandatory on TT-05, TT-18, TT-29

Definition: Receipt voucher reference where the transaction is a collection.
Validation: Mandatory on TT-01, TT-04, TT-13

Definition: The date on which the economic event occurred, exactly as evidenced by the source document.
Validation: Nullable ONLY where date_status is NO DATE IN SOURCE or MISSING; may not exceed the posting date

Definition: The date on which the entry is recognised in the ledger; determines the accounting period.
User Input / System: System-derived from the selected period, user-adjustable within it
Validation: Must fall inside an open period

Definition: The monthly accounting period the entry belongs to.
Validation: Status must be Open at the moment of posting
Source: File 2 Journal cols G and H

Definition: Whether the source document carried a usable date. Preserves the integrity of the 311 undated historical entries.
Validation: One of OK · NO DATE IN SOURCE — not fabricated · Missing Date · Inconsistent Date
Example: ⚠ NO DATE IN SOURCE — not fabricated

Definition: The narration of the transaction, preserved verbatim from the source for migrated entries.
Validation: Minimum 10 characters; may not be edited after posting
Example: تعزيز من السيد محمد عبد الرضا عيدان الشمري

Definition: English narration, optional for locally captured entries.
The general ledger account debited or credited by the line.
Validation: Must be Posting and Active (VR-04)
Source: File 1 Journal cols G and I

Definition: The debit amount of the line in IQD.
Validation: Exactly one of debit or credit must be greater than zero

Definition: The credit amount of the line in IQD.
Validation: Exactly one of debit or credit must be greater than zero

Definition: The project the line belongs to.
Validation: One of PRJ-01, PRJ-02, PRJ-03, CORP

Definition: The functional cost centre. Never a vendor.
Validation: One of the 19 approved cost centres

Definition: The responsibility centre of the custodian or of management.
User Input / System: System-derived for migrated entries, user input thereafter
Validation: Mandatory on all advance transactions

Definition: The external party to the transaction — contractor, supplier, employee, shareholder, government entity or other.
Validation: Mandatory per accounts.requires_counterparty (VR-08)
Source: File 1 Journal col E · File 2 Journal col V

Definition: The named person holding the advance.
Validation: Mandatory on every line touching an advance account (VR-07)

Definition: The specific safe, cash box or bank account moved by the line.
Validation: Mandatory on every line touching 111xxx (VR-06)

Definition: Who provided the funds behind the transaction.
Validation: Mandatory on funding and direct-payment transactions

Definition: The source reference series entry the transaction belongs to; the unit of every funding reconciliation.
Validation: Mandatory on funding-chain transactions

Definition: The approved economic classification of the funding use.
Validation: One of the eleven approved values

Definition: The position of the entry in the funding chain — funding, advance transfer, direct payment, settlement, reclassification or recovery.
User Input / System: System-derived from the transaction type, overridable with approval
Validation: One of the twelve approved chain steps; the account pair must match the step
Example: 3 – SETTLEMENT / تسوية سلفة على حساب المصروف

Definition: The account or entity that physically paid. An audit field only; it never changes the accounting owner of the funding.
Validation: Reportable but never used in a posting rule

Definition: The person or entity that physically received the funds where different from the recorded counterparty.
Whether the cost is capitalised or expensed.
Validation: Mandatory on all cost lines; must agree with the account class

Definition: The asset family the cost belongs to.
Validation: One of Concession CIP · Concession Right · Fixed Asset (Retained) · Advance · Expense · Payable · Receivable · n/a

Definition: Whether the asset is government-titled, must be handed over at expiry, is retained by SHH or is pending classification.
Validation: Mandatory on 115xxx and 118xxx lines

Definition: The contract the transaction executes.
Validation: Mandatory on contractor transactions above the approved threshold (VR-29)

Definition: The work package within the contract.
Whether the supporting evidence is complete, partial or missing.
Validation: Partial and Missing automatically raise an exception that cannot be deleted (VR-13)

Definition: The reference of the supporting document.
Validation: Mandatory when doc_status is Complete (VR-14)

Definition: Which historical source workbook or population the entry came from.
Validation: Mandatory on migrated entries; one of the approved source values

Definition: The identifier of the transaction in its source document.
Validation: Mandatory on migrated entries

Definition: The amount stated in the source document, retained for reconciliation.
System amount less source amount. Any non-zero value raises an exception.
Validation: Must be zero or carry an open exception

Definition: The reconciliation outcome for the entry against its source.
Validation: One of the nine approved values

Definition: Position in the posting workflow.
Validation: Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Approved → Posted; Posted → Reversed only

Definition: Marks an entry loaded from the historical workbooks rather than captured in the system.
Validation: May not be set after the go-live cut-off (VR-54)

Definition: The six-digit approved account code.
Validation: Unique; may not be changed once transactions exist

Definition: Whether the account may be posted to directly.
Validation: Non-posting parents reject all postings (VR-04)

Definition: Whether the account is open for use.
Validation: Inactive accounts reject all postings; deactivation requires a nil balance

Definition: Whether the account normally carries a debit or a credit balance.
Validation: Dr for assets and expenses, Cr for liabilities, equity and revenue
Source: Derived from File 1 COA col D

Definition: The statement line the account maps to.
Validation: Every posting account must map to exactly one line per statement

Definition: The sign applied when presenting the account balance on the statement line.
Validation: Either +1 or −1

Definition: The cash account balance computed from posted transactions.
Validation: Recomputed on every read (VR-57)

Definition: The balance per the bank statement or the physical cash count.
Validation: Requires a supporting document and a responsible accountant (VR-58)

Definition: Book balance less actual balance.
Validation: A non-zero variance leaves the account unreconciled and raises an exception

Definition: The percentage of eligible revenue payable to the State Company for Land Transport.
Validation: Effective-dated; never hardcoded (VR-43)

Definition: Whether the revenue line enters the government share base.
Validation: Mandatory on every 410xxx line; exclusions require a documented reason (VR-44)

Definition: The date operations commence, from which amortization begins.
User Input / System: Parameter, set only by the Finance Manager with a board reference
Validation: NULL until confirmed; the system may never infer it (VR-39)

Definition: The date by which the advance must be settled.
Validation: Drives the aging report and the overdue exception (RE-13)

Definition: Whether the settlement is evidenced, pending evidence or unevidenced.
Validation: Pending Evidence keeps the amount in the advance and raises an exception

Definition: Unique identifier of an exception.
Validation: Unique; never reused; the row may never be deleted (VR-59)

Definition: The value of the field before the change.
Validation: Written on every tracked change

Definition: The value of the field after the change.
Validation: Written on every tracked change

Definition: The justification recorded with the change.
Validation: Mandatory on reversal, reclassification, period reopen and parameter change
Example: إعادة تبويب معتمدة من مجلس الإدارة
